question: whether the certified-edge count and the label-free floor proxies really contradict each other on the two real channels, and if so which of them is measuring something other than symbolisation quality

e1_edges_across_the_floor.hypothesis: H1: that a below-floor instance WITH planted structure might still certify many permutation-surrogate edges, which would dissolve the contradiction

e2_common_cause_at_fixed_difficulty.hypothesis: whether the edge count tracks the amount of real dependence in the channel rather than the quality of the symboliser

e3_cuts_out_of_mechanism.hypothesis: H2: that the proxies respond to properties of a channel other than topic separability, so a cut calibrated on the vocabulary mechanism misfires on a channel that differs in some other way

e4_k_mismatch.hypothesis: H4: that k=8 is wrong for open-chat, so a stable clustering at the wrong k reads as low seed stability while the symbols still work

e5_real_channel_text_shape_and_k.hypothesis: the two mechanisms E3 and E4 found, short messages and a wrong k, checked on the real channels themselves, label free
